product_overview: My Recipe Book is a modern web PWA that lets food lovers create, organize, search, and export personal recipes, with user authentication and an admin dashboard for platform management.
core_goals: Allow users to securely register, log in, and manage personal recipe collections.
Provide full CRUD for recipes including photos, categories, and export-to-PDF functionality.
Offer fast search and categorization to find recipes instantly.
Support PWA capabilities and offline sync to provide a native-like mobile experience.
Expose administrative endpoints for managing users and system metrics.

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Simple API endpoint to verify service availability and basic system health.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with health object (status, uptime, version)
GET /api/health (during partial outage) -> Receive 503 with error object

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Register new users and authenticate returning JWTs for authorized actions.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with {email, password, displayName} -> Receive 200 with created user object
POST /api/auth/login with {email, password} -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/register with existing email -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 with authentication error

features.name: Recipe Management
features.description: Create, read, update, and delete personal recipes including images, categories, prep time and detailed instructions.
user_flows: POST /api/recipes with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {title, ingredients, instructions, category, prepTime, photo} -> Receive 201 with created recipe {id}
GET /api/recipes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with full recipe object
PATCH /api/recipes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {title, instructions} -> Receive 200 with updated recipe object
DELETE /api/recipes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 204 no content
POST /api/recipes with Authorization: Bearer <token> and missing required fields -> Receive 400 with validation errors
DELETE /api/recipes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> for non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Bulk Delete / Clear Recipes
features.description: Allow users to delete many recipes at once or clear their entire recipe collection.
user_flows: DELETE /api/recipes with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {ids:[id1,id2]} -> Receive 200 with deletion summary
DELETE /api/recipes with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {confirm: true} -> Receive 200 with 'all deleted' response
DELETE /api/recipes with Authorization: Bearer <token> and empty ids -> Receive 400 with validation error

features.name: Search & Categorization
features.description: Instant search and category filters to find recipes quickly.
user_flows: GET /api/recipes?search=chocolate&category=Cakes&page=1 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with paginated results
GET /api/recipes?search= (empty query) with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/recipes?category=NonExistent with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with empty results array

features.name: Export to PDF
features.description: Export single or multiple recipes as PDF documents (server-side job or immediate response).
user_flows: POST /api/recipes/export with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {ids:[id1,id2]} -> Receive 200 with {downloadUrl} or binary PDF stream
POST /api/recipes/export with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {ids:[]} -> Receive 400 with validation error

POST /api/recipes/export with Authorization: Bearer <token> when export job queued -> Receive 202 with {jobId} -> GET /api/recipes/export/status/:jobId with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with {status:'completed', downloadUrl}

features.name: User Profile
features.description: View and edit profile details including display name and password changes.
user_flows: GET /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile
PATCH /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {displayName, bio} -> Receive 200 with updated profile
POST /api/profile/password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {currentPassword, newPassword} -> Receive 200 with success message
POST /api/profile/password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and incorrect currentPassword -> Receive 400 with error 'current password incorrect'
GET /api/profile with missing or invalid token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Administrative endpoints for viewing system metrics and managing users (admin-only).
user_flows: GET /api/admin/metrics with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 with metrics {usersCount, recipesCount, activeSessions}
GET /api/admin/users with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 with list of users
PATCH /api/admin/users/:id with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and body {role:'admin'} -> Receive 200 with updated user
GET /api/admin/metrics with non-admin token -> Receive 403 forbidden
PATCH /api/admin/users/:id with malformed body -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: PWA / Offline Sync
features.description: Support for offline usage with local caching and server sync when connectivity is restored.
user_flows: GET /api/recipes?since=timestamp with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with changed recipes since timestamp
POST /api/recipes/sync with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {localChanges:[{tempId, changeType, recipe}]} -> Receive 200 with mapping {tempId:finalId} and sync result
POST /api/recipes/sync with Authorization: Bearer <token> and conflicting change -> Receive 409 conflict with conflict details for manual resolution
GET /api/health while offline -> Network request fails (no response) -> Client uses cached recipes until connectivity returns
